Should Christian wives take their husband’s last name?

October 19, 2026

Dillon Burroughs, The Christian Post, October 19, 2026

Share

In 1855, a suffragist named Lucy Stone refused to take her new husband’s last name, a quiet rebellion that modern feminists view as one of the first major blows against the patriarchy. 

Indeed, in due time, suffragists, Hollywood actresses, female executives, and a huge percentage of third-wave feministsfollowed her lead and decided that the most important decision they could make immediately upon entering holy matrimony was to declare their individualism.
